notes.title: Patch notes for update 1: (27th July 2016)
notes.notes:
When selecting music in the ‘Arcade mode’ the folder opened by default was ‘my document’ – changed it to be the correct folder where the OGG files for the ‘Arcade mode’ are stored by default within the game
    Tutorial page stays longer upon launching any of the game modes – allowing for time to read it
